revenueModel.text: Customers pay recurring monthly fees for monitoring and maintenance, plus installation charges.
revenueModel.evidence: We offer our customers routine maintenance and the installation of upgraded or additional equipment, which provide additional value to the customer and generate incremental recurring monthly revenue.

changes.text: Divested its Commercial business, leaving one reportable segment focused on consumers.
